activity_summary: Sincler came in in black among the colours and said the half-line. Nick answered. The ostlers stopped forking straw. Kemp did not add a word. You said only to come slower, then nothing, and to let them do it. They did it again, and Garnish entered no addition.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said only to come slower, then nothing, and to let them do it.

entities.name: John Sincler
entities.context: Walked on in black, said the half-line, and did not mend it.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Answered, the second time after the black had arrived.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Stayed left of the nail and did not bring the song into the entrance.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Stopped them helping the moment, and kept it small.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Added nothing, and said he was proud of the quiet.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept Berowne out of it, and would not licence a longer speech.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Entered the messenger with no addition in the margin.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Slower in, then nothing

facets.activity: Told Sincler to come slower, then nothing
